rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a young plant, including one raised in a nursery for transplanting.

example.english: This seedling was bought at the flower market and will be transplanted into a pot later.
example.traditional: 呢棵苗係花墟買返嚟，遲啲要移落花盆。
